archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Brighter Dark Theme (Coinbase x Fidelity)
vibe: Welcoming, modern, accessible but professional trading dashboard. Brighter dark tones, deep slate navies over pitch black.

layout.grid_structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
layout.alignment: Left-aligned data, dense and compact but visually clean with generous padding within cards.
layout.surface_style: Flat Solid with subtle roundness. Backgrounds match surface color (#1E293B) with a 1px solid border (#334155). Avoid muddy shadows. Use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for Coinbase-friendly feel.
layout.header: Sticky glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800 z-50.

components.general: Use Shadcn/UI for tables, dropdowns, dialogs, tabs. Customize spacing, radius to rounded-xl, and colors.
components.buttons: Primary CTA rounded-full or rounded-xl, high contrast. Use #0052FF with white text.
components.cards: Subtle border, flat background #1E293B. Hover: slight border color lighten or bg-slate-800.
components.tables: Dense. JetBrains Mono for numbers. Left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Accent Up (Green) and Down (Red) for P&L.
components.charts: Shadcn charts or Recharts. Clear tooltips, minimalistic grid lines (slate-700/50).
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop blur over dashboard.

motion.hover: Transition bg-color and border-color 0.2s ease. NO transform scale on dense dashboard tables.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for grid items (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-2 to 0).

icons.style: Clean, stroke-width 2, sizes 16-24px depending on context.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='broker-connect-btn').

image_urls.description: Abstract glowing lines forming a complex data visualization - useful for banner backgrounds or empty states.
Blue minimal AI avatar for the AI Chat Widget.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a welcoming trading dashboard blending Coinbase (friendly, bright blues, rounded) and Fidelity (trustworthy, green up-ticks).
Base background is slate-900 (#0F172A), completely overriding the previous #0a0a0b pure black.
Implement the 'Control Room' bento grid (grid-cols-4) to layout widgets: Options Radar, Flow Screener, Market Prediction.
Ensure all numbers in the Stock/Crypto Ticker use JetBrains Mono or tabular-nums for alignment.
Implement the Navigation Bar with a sticky glassmorphic header.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, tabs, modal triggers, and form inputs.
